verdict.rationale: Render's docs say you can connect a repo and deploy on every push, and community users call it easier to set up than Heroku. Nothing in the pack shows that build settings are detected automatically or that no manual build configuration is needed; Docker and render.yaml Blueprints suggest some configuration is expected. Missing for 10: documented automatic build/runtime detection (zero-config builds), evidence that no build or start commands are required, and hands-on corroboration of a config-free repo deploy.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my app by simply connecting my repo without manual build configuration

citations.quote: Connect your repo and ship with every push.
it's even easier to setup than Heroku
